ex.s: Especially glbalisation and better communications in the past few decades, all have caused many Languages to disappear, and dominant languages such as English.

ex.s: It will disappear with the development of AI.
ex.t: 如果托尼的理论是正确的，这就解释了为什么当我们错过一晚上的睡眠后，第二天我们会发现更难集中注意力学习新信息——我们的大脑可能留给新体验的空间变小了。

defs.def: to stop existing 不复存在；灭绝；消亡

ex.s: By the end of the run, all my stress has disappeared and I'm ready to face the next day at work.
ex.t: 跑到终点时，我所有的压力都消失了，我已准备好面对第二天的工作。

ex.s: She surfaces, cries in fear, then disappears forever.
ex.t: 她浮出水面，惊恐地尖叫，然后永远消失了。

ex.s: For the most part, he did not mention the children he saved, and his actions soon disappeared from people's memories.
ex.t: 他几乎从未提及自己救过的那些孩子，他的行为很快就从人们的记忆中消失了。

ex.s: It will vanish, pass into future time, and disappear.
ex.t: 它将消失，进入未来的时间，然后消失不见。

ex.s: Beyond that the colours darkened into fine shades of deep blue, and gradually disappeared.
ex.t: 再远处，颜色逐渐变深为深蓝的幽影，最终消失。

defs.def: to be lost or impossible to find 失踪；丢失
